original_high_level_goal.name: Foster Community Engagement and Transparency
original_high_level_goal.description: Provide citizens with the ability to view public reports, follow other citizens' reports, and receive notifications, enhancing community involvement and trust in the reporting process.

actor.name: Citizens
actor.description: Individuals who report issues and malfunctions in the urban environment.

branch_002.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate citizen engagement and transparency in urban issue reporting.
branch_002.rationale: Grounding: The parent HLG is supported by Section C, which details features for viewing public reports, following others, and receiving notifications to strengthen trust. The reconstructed HLG is also supported as it accurately summarizes the intent of these engagement and transparency features described in the documentation. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG accurately captures the core functional intention of fostering engagement and transparency through urban issue reporting, aligning with the parent's focus on citizen involvement and trust. While it omits specific mechanisms like notifications, it preserves the high-level WHY-level objective and actor perspective defined in the documentation.

original_high_level_goal.name: Efficiently review and manage citizen reports
original_high_level_goal.description: To ensure that submitted citizen reports are thoroughly reviewed and appropriately managed, leading to timely approvals or rejections and effective assignment for resolution.

actor.name: Municipal Operators
actor.description: Staff members of the Municipality of Turin who review and manage citizen reports.

branch_003.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective management and resolution of citizen reports by municipal operators.
branch_003.rationale: Grounding: The parent HLG is supported by Section B, which details the review, assignment, and status management workflows performed by municipal operators. The reconstructed HLG is also supported as it accurately summarizes the operator's role in managing the report lifecycle from review to resolution assignment. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention of managing citizen reports by municipal operators, aligning with the documented workflows for review and assignment. While it condenses the specific outcomes of approval/rejection into 'resolution,' it maintains the same actor perspective and high-level objective.

original_high_level_goal.name: Ensure timely resolution of urban issues through effective communication and status updates
original_high_level_goal.description: Facilitate the process for external maintenance personnel to update report statuses and communicate with technical staff, ensuring that reported urban issues are resolved effectively.

actor.name: External Maintenance Personnel
actor.description: Workers from external companies who address specific issues reported by citizens.

branch_004.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective communication and resolution of reported issues by external maintenance personnel.
branch_004.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly details the workflow for external maintenance personnel, including their ability to update report statuses (e.g., from Assigned to In Progress) and communicate with technical staff. The reconstructed HLG accurately captures this functional intention of facilitating resolution and communication for this specific actor. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core functional intention of facilitating communication and issue resolution for external maintenance personnel, aligning with the parent's objective. It maintains the same actor perspective and intended outcome despite more concise wording.

original_high_level_goal.name: Oversee System Operations and Configuration Management
original_high_level_goal.description: Manage and maintain the Participium system to ensure its reliability, security, and continuous improvement, including viewing private statistics and managing system configurations.

actor.name: Administrators
actor.description: Individuals who manage the Participium system and oversee its operations.

branch_005.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Facilitate effective system management and oversight by administrators.
branch_005.rationale: Grounding: The documentation explicitly defines administrator capabilities in Section D (viewing private statistics) and Section B (configuring automatic assignments), supporting the parent HLG's focus on oversight and configuration. The reconstructed HLG accurately summarizes these administrative functions of managing system operations and viewing private data. Alignment: The reconstructed HLG preserves the core intention of administrative oversight and system management defined in the parent HLG. It accurately reflects the actor (administrators) and the high-level goal of managing system operations without losing the essential functional scope.
